# Actions Actionaddtolibrary

This layer handles various actions related to the Excalidraw application, including adding elements to the library, aligning elements, cropping, and deleting selected elements.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for managing different actions within the Excalidraw application.

## How it works

The files in this layer work together to handle various actions within the Excalidraw application. For example, `actionAddToLibrary.ts` registers the action to add elements to the library, while `actionAlign.tsx` provides actions for aligning elements. `actionCanvas.tsx` manages canvas actions like changing background color and zooming.
